notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:2.5} deep, two or three seeds per spot, 1 to 4 weeks after your last frost once the soil is at least {c:18}, then thin to the strongest. For an earlier crop, sow indoors in individual pots 3 to 4 weeks before planting out and handle the roots gently.
notes.care: Each plant needs a space about {cm:90} each way. Water at the base, not the leaves, about {cm:2.5} a week. Mulch once the soil is above {c:24}. Cold, wet or cloudy weather can leave the first fruits unpollinated.
notes.harvest: Pick at {cm:10} to {cm:20} long, while tender and glossy. Check every day or two in warm weather: one plant gives several fruits a week, and missed ones swell into tough marrows.
